recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14412 unless the Financial Management work group wants a new editorial revision unrelated to the original "as are" ambiguity.
issue_request: FHIR-14412 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 technical correction for the Financial module Security and Privacy section, asking whether "as are" was confusing or whether "are" was redundant. A Jira comment recommended changing "as are" to "in addition to".
initial_application: The issue was first touched by git-svn commit cb4678a111 / svn r12999, which changed "is" to "are" and added a comma before "as are". Commit c6368844f5 / svn r13149 then made the requested clarification by changing the phrase to "encouraged in addition to the use of whatever measures...".
additional_context: source/financial-module.html is an active current-build module page referenced from source/hierarchy.xml. The current source uses the clarified wording and no longer contains the confusing phrase in this section. The same historical c6368844f5 commit also handled FHIR-14640, but that separate glossary issue is already represented on the combined branch. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting or more specific community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative source already reflects the accepted FHIR-14412 wording.

related_jiras.note: The same historical commit c6368844f5 also touched the Financial module glossary for FHIR-14640; it is already represented on the combined branch and was not re-decided here.
